title: The Lebanese ambassador to France speaks to FRANCE 24
summary: Israeli strikes hit a Beirut hotel and residential complex in Lebanon's east, Lebanese state media said on March 4th, as Israel announced broad strikes in response to Hezbollah missile and drone launches. "We should have a conference in France to help the Lebanese army to continue its plans" to disarm Hezbollah, Rabih El Chaer, Lebanese ambassador to France…
